array.string: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" export TERM=xterm-256color cd "$HOME/Code" || exit 1 mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Logs" exec >>"$HOME/Library/Logs/claude-remote-control.log" 2>&1 exec /usr/bin/expect -c ' set timeout -1 spawn -noecho claude remote-control --name [exec hostname -s] \ --permission-mode bypassPermissions expect { -re .+ exp_continue eof } exit [lindex [wait] 3] '
